js: 'The labs in the modern design (WP5), on made-up data: the header bar (the title, the model picker as its subtitle, the actions as icon buttons, the presets popover), the form column as preference groups with the prompt as a rounded field, the results head and its cards (scripts/drive/lab-fake.js answers the Image, Decision and Voices labs history, the Decision lab models and the Voices lab rounds), the reference panels opened from their rails, the narrow window Form and Results toggle, and the light theme. It starts nothing and writes nothing (presets are only opened, never saved): safe to run with the GPU hold on. Run: scripts/ui-drive.py scripts/drive/labs-modern.json --dsf 1.25 --block-writes --init-script scripts/drive/lab-fake.js --token-file <dir>.token --base http://<addr> --podman-guard <prefix> --shots <dir>'
